drums.tags: Hard rock instrumental. Distorted electric guitars play syncopated power chord riffs and palm-muted rhythmic patterns. The bass guitar follows the kick drum patterns with a gritty, overdriven tone. Acoustic drums feature a heavy snare, active hi-hat work, and frequent crash cymbal accents. The arrangement alternates between driving riff-based sections and more open, rhythmic passages. 130 BPM, 4/4 time signature, E minor.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[drum stick count-off]
[distorted electric guitar riff enters with syncopated power chords]
[bass and drums enter with driving eighth-note rhythm]

[Section A]
[palm-muted guitar chugging]
[snare hits on beats 2 and 4]
[crash cymbal accents at the end of phrases]

[Section B]
[guitar riff shifts to higher register power chords]
[bass follows kick drum syncopation]

[Section C]
[half-time feel on drums with open hi-hats]
[sustained guitar chords with heavy distortion]

[Outro]
[rapid snare rolls]
[final sustained power chord with guitar feedback]
[abrupt stop]
